multistage.idle_pass_ms.reason: amortized idle tick (~0.003 ms); 5% is below the timer/scheduler noise floor; bench.py keeps a hard 2 ms budget

pipeline.100k.hash_ms.reason: sub-millisecond diagnostic (~0.6 ms); 5% is at the timer/allocation noise floor

pipeline.100k.encode_ms.reason: sub-millisecond diagnostic (~0.1 ms); 5% is at the timer/allocation noise floor

pipeline.1m.extract_ms.reason: 1M scale case; the repeat hot path is apply_inplace and is gated

pipeline.1m.hash_ms.reason: 1M scale case recorded for memory/scale comparison; not a per-frame path

pipeline.1m.encode_ms.reason: 1M scale case recorded for frame-size comparison; not a per-frame path

pipeline.1m.decode_ms.reason: 1M scale case; the repeat hot path is apply_inplace and is gated

pipeline.1m.apply_fresh_ms.reason: 1M full build is a scale case with no budget; apply_inplace is the repeat guard

instances.13x.encode_ms.reason: sub-millisecond diagnostic (~0.2 ms); 5% is at the timer/allocation noise floor

instances.13x.apply_first_ms.reason: one sample per run (first definition build); repeated apply is the gated path

roundtrip.full.prefix_ms.reason: component diagnostic inside the settle gate; the full prefix is cached

roundtrip.full.encode_ms.reason: sub-millisecond component diagnostic inside the settle gate

roundtrip.full.rtt_ms.reason: includes the fake client's own decode/scale/encode; the settle gate covers it

roundtrip.full.apply_ms.reason: component diagnostic inside the settle gate; the first apply is one-shot

roundtrip.ref.prefix_ms.reason: component diagnostic inside the ref settle gate

roundtrip.ref.encode_ms.reason: sub-millisecond component diagnostic inside the ref settle gate

roundtrip.ref.rtt_ms.reason: includes the fake client's own work; the ref settle gate covers it

roundtrip.ref.apply_ms.reason: component diagnostic inside the ref settle gate; the apply is the same cached write
